name: ConnectionStatus
description: Cloud-sync connection indicator: a colored dot plus a phrase, per docs/connection-status.md. `state` is the seven-value enum §1 defines (also the value the live `dataBinding` resolves to at runtime — `state` here is the structural/preview default). `pending` and `detail` are the §4 parameters, meaningful only for the states that carry them (`queued`, `failed`). `pulse` is derived by the host from `state` (§6.1: pulse := state in {checking, syncing, failed}) and rendered solid under Reduce Motion / prefers-reduced-motion — it is not duplicated per state.

state.description: One of the seven connection-status states (docs/connection-status.md §1), in that exact spelling. Drives the color.conn.<state> token and the settings.cloud.status.<state> phrase.

dataBinding.description: Registered binding (design/actions.json) that resolves the live value of `state` — 'sync.connectionState'.

pending.description: Queue depth. Only rendered when state == 'queued' (§4); selects settings.cloud.status.queued.one vs .other.

detail.description: Diagnostic detail string for 'queued'/'failed' (§4). Not localized, surfaced on hover (macOS) / tap (web), never inline.

pulse.description: Derived from state (§6.1), never authored per-state. Solid under Reduce Motion.
